thread:
Kai: Hey team, Kai here (data infra, day 3). Trying to map who to ping for: Dedicated GPU pool invites, routing policy changes, model-variant fallback rules, and alert threshold edits. Want to avoid spamming the wrong channels.

AccessOps-bot: Welcome Kai! Starter page: https://wiki.redwood.com/onboarding. For access, use the AccessOps flow or DM AccessOps. See: https://boards.redwood.com/accessops/requests.

Luz: Quick map: AccessOps (AccessOps team) handles Dedicated invites and quotas. eng-platform owns routing policy config (latency/cost/region). eng-runtime owns model fallback behaviors and model-variant testing.

Kai: Thanks. If I need to run a routing experiment in staging, is there a sandbox policy key or special flag?

Mason: Yes 389: use sandbox key "rsandbox-<team>" and run the canary with 100-200 requests first. Add label routing-experiment to the PR. There's a short checklist in the routing runbook.

Kai: For Dedicated GPU access, what's the request command and expected turnaround?

AccessOps-bot: Run:
```
/request-gpu --pool=dev-gpu-3 --env=staging --reason="integration tests" --owner=@Kai
```
Turnaround usually 24h; mark as urgent to fast-track.

Kai: Cool. If the pool quota isn't enough during a spike, who escalates?

Luz: Open an infra-requests ticket and tag "capacity-planning". For emergencies DM @Luz or @Zoe. eng-runtime can approve short-lived burst increases for tests.

Kai: Who to page for runtime model regressions (e.g., hallucination spike or sudden latency increase)?

Mason: Page @eng-runtime-oncall first for model behavior or serving regressions. If infra nodes are failing or there's a networking incident, page @eng-sre. For customer-impacting incidents follow the incident playbook and page @product-oncall. Playbook: https://playbooks.redwood.com/model-regressions

Kai: If I change alert thresholds (minor tweak) who reviews the PR?

Zoe: Minor tweaks = PR to infra-alerts with @eng-sre and @eng-runtime as reviewers and short rationale. Major threshold changes need a 15-min sync with SRE and an entry in the change log.

Kai: Is there a single canonical owners list I can consult? I couldn't find a consolidated mapping in the handbook.

Luz: Canonical list is in the handbook owners page and we also maintain owners@redwood.com as an alias for cross-team questions. If you find gaps, open a handbook PR and tag ops to update.

Kai: Awesome, that helps a lot. I'll file the GPU request and start a sandbox routing PR. Thanks y'all!

Mason: Welcome aboard 44b happy to walk through routing later if you want a quick tour.

Kai: Might take you up on that 60a"
